environment.description: AWS Lambda function running Python 3.9 runtime on standard Amazon Linux 2 container. Function has 512MB memory, 30s timeout. IAM role grants s3:GetObject and logs:PutLogEvents. Lambda is invoked via API Gateway with no request validation. /tmp is a standard 512MB ephemeral volume shared across warm invocations. No Lambda extensions or layers installed. Default Lambda execution environment with standard syscall availability.
